title: CAROLINA REAPER // DORNISH HABANERO WARFARE
narrative: Oberyn smiles as he twirls his eight-foot ash spear before the duel with the Mountain. 'People whispered that I soaked this tip in manticore venom or tears of Lys,' he chuckles to Ellaria Sand. 'Nonsense! I made a triple-fermented Dornish Carolina Reaper ghost pepper salsa with roasted garlic and habanero mash! When I scratch Gregor, it won't be poison that kills him—it will be four million Scoville heat units searing through his bloodstream!'
resolvesPlotHole: The Manticore Venom Was Just Ghost Pepper Salsa
introducesPlotHole: Dornish Ghost Pepper Hot Sauce Biochemical Warfare
